subject: Information Theory
title: Entropy and Bayesian Updating
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Entropy and Bayesian Updating.

hook.text: Before the coin flip, you're maximally uncertain. After seeing 100 heads in a row, your belief shifts. Entropy drops.

buildup.text: Bayesian updating adjusts your probability beliefs as evidence arrives. Entropy tracks the shrinking uncertainty.

discovery.text: Each observation narrows the posterior distribution—peaks sharpen, tails shrink, entropy falls.

twist.text: But surprising evidence can temporarily raise entropy by spreading probability over more hypotheses.

climax.text: On average, evidence always reduces entropy. Individual surprises are just detours on the path to certainty.

punchline.text: Update your beliefs, watch uncertainty shrink.

quiz.question: How does Bayesian updating typically affect entropy?
options: It has no effect on entropy
